vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hi, friends! Look, it's our big clothes closet!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Let's learn the clothes, in English, and in French!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Leo puts on his hat! So cool!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A T-shirt with a big yellow star!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Mila twirls in her dress! Twirl, twirl!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Quiz time! Where is the T-shirt?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Leo puts his pants on... backwards! Oops! Ha ha!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Socks on our feet! Wiggle your toes!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Shoes for running! Ready, set, go!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Quiz time! Where are the shoes?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: A warm coat for a cold, cold day!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The scarf goes round and round my neck!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Gloves on our hands! Wiggle your fingers!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Quiz time! Where is the coat?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Boots for jumping in puddles! Splash!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Now let's say them all in French! Listen, and say it too!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Weather game! Brrr, it's snowing! What do we wear?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A coat, a scarf, and gloves! Nice and warm!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Pitter patter, it's raining! What do we wear?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: What do YOU like to wear? Tell a grown-up!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I love my boots, for big puddles!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: And I love my twirly dress!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Time to put the clothes away. Bye-bye, friends!
